yoga_check.description: Saturn in H1 (natal). JSON Ready V6 — Logic Unit 23.1

interpretation.summary: Saturn in H1 — The Ruin Rule
interpretation.detailed: If Saturn is in the 1st house and the native builds or arranges to build a house, the outcome is poverty and total ruin. Exception: if no planets occupy both the 7th and 10th houses simultaneously, construction becomes auspicious — the ruin rule activates only when H7 or H10 is occupied.

interpretation.summary: Saturn in H2 — Venus Sign (Auspicious Construction)

interpretation.summary: Saturn in H3 — Mercury Enmity (Three Dogs Remedy)
interpretation.detailed: Saturn in the 3rd house creates Mercury Enmity — both Saturn and Mercury are rendered 'impotent' in this configuration, making standard construction problematic. Remedy: keep three dogs as pets before and during construction to facilitate the building process and neutralize the enmity.

interpretation.summary: Saturn in H4 — In-Law Affliction (Foundation Veto)
interpretation.detailed: Saturn in the 4th house creates enmity with the Moon. Starting to dig the foundation brings immediate trouble and problems to the maternal grandfather and in-laws. The Lal Kitab instruction is: do not build your own house with this placement.

interpretation.summary: Saturn in H5 — Son's Penalty (Age 48 + Buffalo Remedy)
interpretation.detailed: Saturn in the 5th house: building a house causes an ill effect on the son. Exception: if the son himself builds the house, the outcome is auspicious. If the native must build: wait until the native reaches age 48 AND bring a buffalo, mark it, and feed it before starting construction.

yoga_check.description: Saturn in H6 (natal). Additional Info — Saturn House Rules H06

interpretation.summary: Saturn in H6 — Virgo (Age 39 Rule, Daughter's Relatives)
interpretation.detailed: Saturn in the 6th house (Virgo-friendly sign): the native should build only after reaching the age of 39. Building before age 39 ruins the daughter's relatives (the family of married daughters). After age 39, construction proceeds without this penalty.

yoga_check.description: Saturn in H7 (natal). Additional Info — Saturn House Rules H07

interpretation.summary: Saturn in H7 — Threshold Rule (Ready-Made Houses Favorable)
interpretation.detailed: Saturn in the 7th house: ready-made (pre-built) houses are favorable for the native to buy and occupy. If the native is selling a house, they must keep the oldest threshold (chaukhat — the door frame) to ensure future construction capacity is retained.

yoga_check.description: Saturn in H8 (natal). Additional Info — Saturn House Rules H08

interpretation.summary: Saturn in H8 — Death Veto (Scorpio / Mars Sign)
interpretation.detailed: Saturn in the 8th house (Scorpio/Mars sign) is the most severe construction veto. Death starts to circle the native the moment building begins. The specific death effects vary depending on the positions of Rahu and Ketu in the chart — their house placements determine who in the family is affected and the timeline of the crisis.

Warning: building from the native's own earnings without this trigger causes the father's death with certainty upon completion of the 3rd house (third room or floor).

interpretation.detailed: Saturn in the 10th house creates a money trap: the native earns well until the moment house construction begins, then becomes poor. If Saturn is additionally weak in the chart, the house remains permanently incomplete — the native cannot finish what they started.

interpretation.summary: Right-Angle Structure — Four 90° Corners as Gold Standard
interpretation.detailed: A house with four right angles (90-degree corners) is the gold standard for auspiciousness in Lal Kitab construction logic. Any non-rectangular shape — octagon, pentagon, polygon, triangle, or fish-belly — carries a specific familial penalty defined by the deviated angle. Only four right-angle construction is recommended.

yoga_check.description: Calculated formula — requires length and breadth of the proposed house plot.

interpretation.summary: Remainder Formula — (L+B)×3÷8 Complete Vibe Diagnostic
interpretation.detailed:
Construction auspiciousness formula: (Length + Breadth) × 3 ÷ 8. Evaluate the remainder for the house's 'vibe':
Remainder 1 — Royal Honor: Jupiter in H1 energy. Excellent.
Remainder 2 — Poverty: Jupiter in H6. Native faces financial hardship.
Remainder 3 — Lion's Den: Mars in H3. Good for trade; bad for children.
Remainder 4 — Starvation: Moon in H4. Two meals difficult to earn daily.
Remainder 5 — Peace: Sun in H5. Wife and children get happiness.
Remainder 6 — Directionless: Sun in H6. Loss of happiness.
Remainder 7 — Excellent: Venus in H7. Best outcome.
Remainder 8 — Death Dwelling: Mars + Saturn in H8. Extreme inauspicious.
Auspicious: 1, 3 (trade only), 5, 7. Inauspicious: 2, 4, 6, 8.

interpretation.detailed: A structural dosha arises when the house is the last house of a lane (dead-end position) OR when air blows directly from the street into the house. Both conditions cause problems for children and wife, including blindness, joint pain, or remaining unmarried.

interpretation.summary: Main Entrance Direction — East Best, South Lethal for Females
interpretation.detailed:

East — Excellent; total joy for the family.
West — Second best; generally good.
North — Superb; happy journey through life.
South — Jinxed and lethal specifically for females in the household. A south-facing main entrance should be avoided, especially when Saturn is in H11.

interpretation.summary: Peepal Tree Shadow — House Doomed if Shadow Falls on Home
interpretation.detailed: If the shadow of a Peepal tree falls on the house at any time of day, the area is considered doomed. Remedies: (A) Water the Peepal tree's roots AND pour milk into a nearby well; OR (B) Water a Keekar tree every Saturday before dawn for 40 consecutive Saturdays.

yoga_check.description: Saturn in H4 or H8 (natal) — triggers on act of digging foundation.

interpretation.summary: Immediate Danger Gate — Saturn H4/H8 + Foundation Dug
interpretation.detailed: Immediate Crisis Gate: IF Saturn is in H4 OR H8 AND the foundation is dug, the result is an immediate crisis warning — high risk to in-laws (H4) or to the native's own life (H8). Lal Kitab categorizes this as a veto: stop construction immediately. Additional context: if Saturn's position is made auspicious via Rahu/Ketu configurations, the native will construct houses repeatedly throughout life — the longevity-of-construction check is the positive variant of this gate.

interpretation.summary: Fixed Oven (Bhatti) + Mars in H8 — Family Ruin Trigger
interpretation.detailed: A fixed oven (bhatti) that has been sealed closed with earth inside the home is a 'ticking bomb.' If a child is born with Mars in the 8th house while the family lives in a house with this sealed bhatti, the entire family is ruined. The bhatti must be permanently opened or removed before such a child is born.

interpretation.summary: Uncle in Saturn's Room — Sun+Saturn in H4 Death Veto
interpretation.detailed: If both Sun and Saturn occupy the 4th house, the native's uncle will certainly die in the room designated for Saturn (typically the left side of the house used for iron storage). This is a specific family fatality veto for the paternal uncle when the Saturn/Sun H4 combination is present.

interpretation.summary: Pushya Nakshatra — Mandatory Construction Start and Completion
interpretation.detailed: Pushya Nakshatra is mandatory for both starting AND completing construction to ensure auspicious results. The groundbreaking ceremony AND the final grihapravesh (housewarming) must be timed to occur when Pushya Nakshatra is active. Using any other Nakshatra for these milestone events removes the auspicious protection.
